1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_000020_ICEHEART
1.description: Comrades! Sheathe your swords! There is no need for further bloodshed!

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_000050_ICEHEART
4.description: Hear me, brothers and sisters! The war is ended! Nidhogg is no more!

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_000060_ICEHEART
5.description: Aye, it is so! This adventurer and the Azure Dragoon laid the great wyrm low!

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_000070_ICEHEART
6.description: The endless cycle of violence between man and dragon was born of our forefathers' treachery.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_000080_ICEHEART
7.description: You have followed me─bled with me─to bring this truth to light, that we might all know peace!

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_000090_ICEHEART
8.description: But Nidhogg is dead─Nidhogg is dead, my friends! He who bore such hatred towards Ishgard is dead!

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_000100_ICEHEART
9.description: Let his hatred die with him, I say! Let us sheathe our swords and go in peace!

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_000120_ICEHEART
11.description: No, my friend, far from it! At long last, the peace for which we have so desperately fought is within our grasp! And I for one would not forsake it!

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_000140_TEMPLEKNIGHT2
13.description: Seize the witch! Let none escape!

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_000150_HAURCHEFANT
14.description: Providing aid and succor to the wounded should be our first concern.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_000160_HAURCHEFANT
15.description: If the heretics mean to observe the peace, then it would be folly not to do the same!

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100020_HAURCHEFANT
17.description: My safety was never in doubt, Father, for I had the Azure Dragoon and the Warrior of Light by my side.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100030_HAURCHEFANT
18.description: We bring the most wonderful tidings!

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100040_EDMONT
19.description: The infamous Lady Iceheart, here in Ishgard? This is most unexpected...

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100050_AYMERIC
20.description: She has done much to quell the violence. The inquisition may not approve, but we are glad of her presence.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100060_EDMONT
21.description: And with the great wyrm's demise, even our nation's more reactionary elements will have scant grounds to press for her immediate impeachment.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100080_ALPHINAUD
23.description: What of the truth revealed to us by Hraesvelgr? That the origins of the Dragonsong War─a core tenet of Ishgardian faith─are quite unlike those depicted in the scriptures.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100090_AYMERIC
24.description: ...That men and dragons once lived together in harmony, and that it was man's treachery which shattered the peace and plunged our peoples into war.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100100_EDMONT
25.description: The same scripture also describes the origins of the High Houses. Were it exposed as false, the legitimacy of our rule would be called into question.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100110_EDMONT
26.description: If both highborn and lowborn can trace their ancestry to Thordan and his knights twelve...

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100120_ALPHINAUD
27.description: But a single sip of dragon's blood is required to confirm their lineage.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100130_AYMERIC
28.description: If the Holy See knew of this and chose to remain silent, their crimes are grievous indeed. Regardless, this state of affairs cannot be allowed to continue.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100140_EDMONT
29.description: Ser Aymeric! You cannot mean to raise this matter with the archbishop!?

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100150_HAURCHEFANT
30.description: Pray consider what you are proposing! If the Holy See chose to conceal the truth for centuries, what reason would they have to reveal it now!?

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100160_ALPHINAUD
31.description: At best, you will be branded a heretic and clapped in irons!

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100170_AYMERIC
32.description: Then, at least, the archbishop will have shown his true colors. My friends, this war will never truly be at an end until the truth is made known.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100180_AYMERIC
33.description: You must see what lies on the horizon if it is not. When ruled by fear of a common enemy, we were united.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100190_AYMERIC
34.description: But now we have none. During the war, the highborn needed men to lead, and the lowborn, men to follow. Not anymore. 'Tis but a matter of time before the old order is called into question.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100200_AYMERIC
35.description: Lady Iceheart will share the truth with her followers, and the Holy See will be powerless to stop its spread. The disenfranchised will rise up, united, and blood will flow in the streets once more...

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_100210_AYMERIC
36.description: A divided Ishgard will not survive.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200010_ALPHINAUD
38.description: My lady, is it wise to let him go?

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200020_ALPHINAUD
39.description: I sympathize with the lord commander's desire for reform, but to approach the archbishop in this manner bespeaks an idealism to which I did not think Ser Aymeric prone.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200030_LUCIA
40.description: Though he comports himself as a realist, he has long dreamt of reform. 'Twas that idealism which first drew me to him─that which made me swear an oath to serve.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200040_LUCIA
41.description: We must not think of ways to hinder his cause, but rather ways to aid it─even should the Holy See cry heresy.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200060_LUCIA
43.description: If the lord commander does not return from the Vault at the appointed hour, I mean to go and fetch him.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200070_EDMONT
44.description: Have care, my lady─your words border on treason! Should they reach the wrong ears, you would be declared an enemy of Ishgard!

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200080_LUCIA
45.description: That is a risk I am willing to take. Lest you forget, my lord─I am not born of this land. My loyalty is to the lord commander alone.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200090_LUCIA
46.description: But I speak only of what may come to pass. If the rumors regarding his heritage are to be believed, we have naught to fear.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200120_LUCIA
49.description: That Ser Aymeric is the archbishop's bastard son.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200130_LUCIA
50.description: Senior clergy are not permitted to marry and sire children. But even the holiest among us are not immune to temptation.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200140_ALPHINAUD
51.description: I labor to believe it... Ser Aymeric is truly the archbishop's son?

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200150_LUCIA
52.description: He has never been publicly acknowledged as such, but the rumors have plagued him since childhood.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200160_LUCIA
53.description: That he rose to his current position, despite being despised as a bastard, and accused of profiting from his father's influence, bespeaks the quality of his character.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200170_LUCIA
54.description: It is my hope that on this occasion, the burden of his birth will work in his favor. Should our worst fears be realized, the archbishop will not be so quick to execute his own flesh and blood, affording us time to mount a rescue.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200180_ESTINIEN
55.description: Bastard or trueborn, he is our nation's best hope. If the Holy See dares to threaten him, I shall lead the charge against the Vault myself.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200190_HAURCHEFANT
56.description: Hear, hear! The future of Ishgard rests on Ser Aymeric's shoulders! I too will do mine utmost to aid his cause!

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200210_HAURCHEFANT
58.description: A knight lives to serve, Father─to aid those in need! The people need Ser Aymeric─more than ever─and we may be his only hope!

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200220_HAURCHEFANT
59.description: There is no greater calling for a knight than to save the life of his fellow man. I swear to you, on the sigil of our house, that I shall do this and make you proud.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200230_EDMONT
60.description: Even you? <sigh> Romantic, reckless fools, the lot of you. So be it─make your preparations.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_200240_LUCIA
61.description: I thank you all for your support.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_300010_REVOLUTIONARY1
62.description: Where d'you think you're goin', missy?

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_300020_TATARU
63.description: I-I-I'm sorry, I didn't mean to offend!

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_300040_REVOLUTIONARY1
65.description: What's it to you, boy!? Piss off!

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_300050_REVOLUTIONARY2
66.description: Hold on! I've seen them around. They're in and out of House Fortemps's manor all the time.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_300060_REVOLUTIONARY1
67.description: Ohhh, I see. Skulkin' about at your highborn masters' biddin', eh? Bloodhounds hopin' to catch a whiff of heresy, is that it?

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_300070_ALPHINAUD
68.description: You are quite mistaken, I assure you. We came here to help. And if you know what's good for you, you will let us pass!

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_300080_REVOLUTIONARY1
69.description: Haha! Listen to the pup's yappin'! Come here, boy─I'll give you cause to yelp!

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_300090_HILDA
70.description: (-???-)Enough! Leave threatenin' women and children to our “betters”! We don't have the knack!

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_300110_HILDA
72.description: Lay a finger on the blue bloods' pups and you're like to lose the hand.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_300120_HILDA
73.description: It ain't often I get called on by <hex:021A020203>glorious<hex:021A020103> heroes like yourself. So tell me: what have I done to deserve you?

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400010_HILDA
74.description: ...So while you were on your way to kill Nidhogg, you stumbled on some dirty secrets that the Holy See has been hidin' for centuries.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400020_REVOLUTIONARY1
75.description: Eh? What are they on about?

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400030_HILDA
76.description: The High Houses, and what makes a nobleman so bleedin' noble. They trace their blood back to King Thordan and his knights twelve─the founders of Ishgard.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400040_HILDA
77.description: But our friends here reckon we're <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> descended from the heroes of eld─highborn and lowborn alike.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400050_HILDA
78.description: And so Ser Aymeric, lord commander of the Temple Knights, has gone to ask the archbishop if he wouldn't mind lettin' everyone know.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400060_REVOLUTIONARY2
79.description: Is he simple!? The old bastard'll have him executed for heresy!

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400070_HILDA
80.description: Well, seems to me that's what the good ser wants. Seems he thinks a noble sacrifice will serve to prove his claims.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400080_ALPHINAUD
81.description: We cannot stand idly by and allow Ser Aymeric to do this. Ishgard has need of him.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400090_HILDA
82.description: Look, you've a good heart. I can see that. Willin' to risk your neck for someone else, even when his troubles ain't yours. But what's this got to do with me?

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400100_ALPHINAUD
83.description: If Ser Aymeric is imprisoned in the Vault, we will need all the help we can muster to breach their defenses and rescue him.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400120_CHARIBERT
85.description: <sniff> Ahhh, the unmistakable scent of heresy...

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400130_CHARIBERT
86.description: And what do we have here? The honored guests of House Fortemps consorting with the queen of rats?

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400140_CHARIBERT
87.description: Oooh. Plotting insurrection I shouldn't wonder! Tsk-tsk. That won't do.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400150_CHARIBERT
88.description: Sickness is wont to fester and spread. It must be burned out ere the infection takes hold.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400160_HILDA
89.description: I reckon ser'd be happy to wield the irons himself. Well, so happens I've got irons of my own.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400170_CHARIBERT
90.description: Ahahaha! Such simple creatures, rats. <hex:021A020203>Certain<hex:021A020103> to attack when cornered.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_400180_CHARIBERT
91.description: Let us step outside, milady. In here, your toys could hurt someone.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500010_CHARIBERT
92.description: There's no denying your gifts... A well-deserved reputation indeed.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500050_ALPHINAUD
96.description: Nay...'tis we who are lucky. Had we fought on, 'twas but a matter of time before our conflict claimed the life of an innocent bystander.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500060_LUCIA
97.description: I thought the Heavens' Ward might come here as well.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500070_HAURCHEFANT
98.description: They came to the Temple Knights' headquarters?

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500080_LUCIA
99.description: Aye. Ser Grinnaux announced that the lord commander had been imprisoned under suspicion of heresy, and that the Heavens' Ward had been granted full authority in his stead.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500090_HAURCHEFANT
100.description: Then the Heavens' Ward now commands the Temple Knights...

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500100_LUCIA
101.description: Those still loyal to Ser Aymeric answer to me. Alas, that amounts to but half our number.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500110_LUCIA
102.description: The other half, who opposed his promotion to lord commander, have gathered at the Vault as ordered.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500120_HILDA
103.description: Bolsterin' the guard already, eh? If I didn't know any better, I'd say you're expected.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500130_LUCIA
104.description: I take it you're in charge around here?

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500140_HILDA
105.description: Hilda, and yes. The young master was just persuadin' me to join his lost cause. Convincin' little beggar, isn't he?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500150_HILDA
106.description: Aye, your passion moved me─a bit. That, and the fact that we're sick of livin' off the leavin's of our “betters.”

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_500160_HILDA
107.description: If you've a mind to change things around here, then we've a mind to join you!

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_600010_CHARIBERT
108.description: Our power... How can this be!?

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_600041_ESTINIEN
112.description: For a mercy, we were not too late.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_600050_AYMERIC
113.description: Why must you do this, Father!?

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_600060_AYMERIC
114.description: Nidhogg is fallen! There is no need for further deception! Now is the time to renounce the lies which led us down this path─to start anew!

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_600070_THORDAN
115.description: And tear down the very pillars of our society─our history, our values─everything we have built over a thousand years? <sigh> A fool to the last.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_600105_ALPHINAUD
119.description: It's no good... The wound is too deep. It refuses to mend...

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_600110_HAURCHEFANT
120.description: You...you are unharmed? F-Forgive me... I could not bear the thought of...of...

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_600120_HAURCHEFANT
121.description: Oh, do not look at me so.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_600121_HAURCHEFANT
122.description: A smile better suits a hero...

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_700020_EDMONT
124.description: A knight lives to serve. To protect. To sacrifice. There is no greater calling.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_700030_EDMONT
125.description: Leave me to mourn, and give chase. For my son, and for the nation he loved. Go.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_800010_AYMERIC
128.description: My friends. I am in your debt.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_800020_ALPHINAUD
129.description: Think nothing of it. Your wounds are healing well, I trust?

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_900010_AYMERIC
131.description: The founding, the scriptures─a thousand years of lies─all to deceive the common man!

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_900020_AYMERIC
132.description: Nay, our own brothers and sisters─for the blood of the knights twelve flows within <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> our veins! You knew this to be true. You knew and you concealed it!

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_900030_THORDAN
133.description: I should be interested to hear how you came by this knowledge. But yes, you have the right of it.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_A00010_THORDAN
134.description: The architects of Ishgard, King Thordan and his knights twelve, entrapped and butchered the great wyrm Ratatoskr, that they might partake of her eyes, and thereby transcend their mortal limits.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_A00020_THORDAN
135.description: Upon learning of their treachery, Nidhogg was consumed with a murderous─and justified─rage. I daresay you know what followed...

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_A00030_AYMERIC
136.description: The great wyrm slew the king and half of his knights.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_A00040_THORDAN
137.description: Aye...but Nidhogg was subdued, and his eyes plucked from their sockets by the knights that remained.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_A00050_THORDAN
138.description: Their one mistake was to show mercy, for from his brother Hraesvelgr did Nidhogg receive a new eye, thus rejuvenating his form and empowering him to embark upon an eternal quest for vengeance.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_A00060_AYMERIC
139.description: ...Whilst Thordan's son Haldrath took one of Nidhogg's eyes and learned to wield its power in defense of his people...

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_A00070_THORDAN
140.description: Thus was the first Azure Dragoon born. And ever since that time, his honored successors have risen to drive Nidhogg from our lands whenever the wyrm has returned to plague us.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00010_THORDAN
141.description: I ask you, my son: will you answer for my sins? Will your son and his son answer for me as well?

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00030_THORDAN
143.description: If a man cannot atone for his sins in the course of his all-too-fleeting life, must his progeny then be held to account? Must every subsequent generation be judged as well?

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00040_THORDAN
144.description: Thordan's betrayal of Ratatoskr was an unconscionable, unforgivable sin.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00050_THORDAN
145.description: Should we, then, as his descendants, meekly surrender ourselves to an eternity of punishment?

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00060_THORDAN
146.description: Nay, say I. I would not see our children sacrificed in a vain attempt to appease an implacable foe.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00070_THORDAN
147.description: Dragons are not like us, my son. To they who live forever, the wrongs of antiquity are as those of yesterday. No reparations shall ever suffice.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00080_THORDAN
148.description: This fact alone should serve as ample justification for our actions, yet some refuse to see it as such. For men like you, who yearn to commit themselves to a nobler cause, a more compelling narrative is required.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00090_AYMERIC
149.description: This is your solution!? This is how you protect our people?

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00100_AYMERIC
150.description: You have given us a <hex:021A020203>lost<hex:021A020103> cause! A death sentence! With your compelling narrative, you but doom our countrymen to give their lives for a lie!

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00110_THORDAN
151.description: And they do so gladly. Highborn and lowborn alike are proud to serve─to fight and die for their country.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00120_THORDAN
152.description: And what would you say to them?

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00130_THORDAN
153.description: What would you tell the wives who have lost their husbands, the mothers who have lost their sons? ...That their loved ones died for naught?

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00150_THORDAN
155.description: Over the course of a thousand years, countless men have donned these robes, and every one of them came to accept the necessity of this solution. Once, I hoped you might come to accept it as well.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00160_THORDAN
156.description: Do not despair, my son. Soon I shall free us from the sins of antiquity...

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00170_THORDAN
157.description: ...And bring about the change you so fervently desire.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_B00180_THORDAN
158.description: If he has spoken with others, I would have their names. Escort him to a cell and question him─thoroughly.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00010_ALPHINAUD
160.description: You saw something, did you not? A vision of the past?

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00020_AYMERIC
161.description: So this is the power of the Echo. Would that it had shown you a finer moment from my past.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00030_AYMERIC
162.description: 'Twas an exercise in futility, as you saw. Faced with the firmity of his conviction, and his many ready rejoinders, my words deserted me. To be frank, I am embarrassed to recall it.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00040_ALPHINAUD
163.description: A friend once impressed upon me the importance of differentiating between words, deeds, and beliefs. Were he here, I suspect he would judge your father's “conviction” to be no more than rank, self-serving delusion.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00050_ALPHINAUD
164.description: Even so, I cannot help but wonder what manner of “change” he intends to bring about.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00060_AYMERIC
165.description: I have given some thought to that as well.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00070_AYMERIC
166.description: During the battle within the Vault, the Heavens' Ward demonstrated strange and unnatural abilities.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00080_LUCIA
167.description: Aye, the manner in which Ser Zephirin struck down Lord Haurchefant was unlike anything I've ever seen before.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00090_AYMERIC
168.description: The spectacle called to mind King Thordan and his knights twelve as they are depicted in scripture─holy powers and all...

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00100_ALPHINAUD
169.description: Mere fabrications...which have become objects of faith...instilled with the belief of countless devoted souls...

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00120_AYMERIC
171.description: If Lady Iceheart can use her own body as a vessel for summoning, I see no reason why others could not...

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00130_LUCIA
172.description: Are the Heavens' Ward truly so reckless?

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00150_AYMERIC
174.description: As they fled, my father spoke of Azys Lla.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00160_AYMERIC
175.description: Though I know not what he intends, I fear no good shall come of it. His ambitions are too great, and his minions too powerful...

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03004_C00170_AYMERIC
176.description: We must find the Heavens' Ward, and stop my father, before it is too late.
